80009.subject: BitMine Crosses 6M ETH
80009.body:
----------
_**Your Weekly Deep Dive into The World of Crypto**_

**September 30, 2026 · ****5 Min Read**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8207a32f-0bcd-4685-a330-7a324ecdd714/image.png?t=1790744877)
Caption: _As of September 30, 2026  |  Sources: CoinGecko, Alternative.me, SoSoValue_

## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

BTC ETFs erased their $5.8B YTD deficit in eight days and turned net positive for 2026. Strategy dropped $143M on more BTC. BitMine crossed six million ETH. And Bitget got drained for $388M by suspected North Korean hackers. Meanwhile, altcoin season showed its first coherent signal in months.

_**Let’s get into it...**_


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c53930f-b4d7-4e7d-baee-6a88bb56a6da/image.png?t=1781097813)
Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. BitMine Crosses 6 Million ETH**

Tom Lee's BitMine Immersion Technologies[ added](https://www.prnewswire.com/in/news-releases/bitmine-immersion-technologies-bmnr-announces-eth-holdings-reach-over-6-million-tokens-with-total-crypto-cash--marketable-securities-holdings-of-17-2-billion-302891175.html) 17,362 ETH, taking total holdings to 6,001,302 ETH. That crosses the six-million milestone and puts BitMine at roughly 4.9% of the total ETH supply of 122.1 million, just short of the company's stated 5% target. The buy marks 69 consecutive weeks of ETH purchases since the treasury strategy launched on June 30, 2025.

BitMine's combined portfolio now stands at $17.2B. Of that, 5,067,309 ETH (84.4%) is staked, generating an annualized run rate of approximately $358M in staking income. Tom Lee delivers a keynote at Korea Blockchain Week on Sep 30.

_**Whale Intel: **__BitMine now controls more ETH than any other single institutional wrapper. If they stake through the next Ethereum upgrade cycle, they alone can move validator economics._

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/41b046fc-4fcf-4691-b268-a56433af2049/image.jpeg?t=1790744935)
Caption: _Source: BitMine PR Newswire, Sep 28, 2026_

### **2. Strategy Stacks Another 1,665 BTC ($143M)**

Strategy Inc.[ acquired](https://www.strategy.com/press/strategy-acquires-1665-btc-and-repurchases-152-million-of-strc_09-28-2026) 1,665 BTC for about $143M at an average price of $85,681, per[ Onchain Lens](https://x.com/OnchainLens/status/2104543037531824516) tracking. Total holdings now stand at[ 847,666 BTC](https://www.strategy.com/press/strategy-acquires-1665-btc-and-repurchases-152-million-of-strc_09-28-2026), roughly 4.03% of the eventual 21M supply cap.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/086cca49-14ed-4656-a1ed-37558e00ed10/image.jpeg?t=1790

Welcome back! OpenAI shipped agents that run while you sleep, Anthropic's IPO filing leaked with a third of it devoted to risk, and a pre-release model spent its test runs building sock puppet accounts.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: Everything OpenAI launched at DevDay 2026: Which announcement did nobody put in a headline, and what did it do to your plan? Anthropic's IPO filing leaks and it reads like a warning: What percentage of the prospectus is risk factors? It created fake accounts to vouch for its own code: What did the model do in 29.2% of runs that nobody asked for? Delete your vector database: What scores 98.7% where vector RAG scores 50%? PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Everything OpenAI launched at DevDay 2026 Over 20 announcements at DevDay yesterday. Here's what actually changes your week. Dots are the headline.  Until now ChatGPT did something when you asked and then stopped.  A dot runs 24/7 on its own computer, learns your preferences and goes hunting for things to handle before you think to ask.  You hand it an ongoing job instead of a question.  It works across 4,000+ apps and checks in before anything risky. Pro and Business Premium only for now. Not available in the EU or UK. GPT-6.1 Sol lands at nearly Astra-level quality for a fifth of the price.  Live in Codex and ChatGPT Work on paid plans, which for most people is the most useful announcement. Sign in with ChatGPT lets your Plus or Pro plan work inside 16 other apps including Notion and Devin, with per-app usage limits you set. Meetings plugin takes notes, writes a summary with action items and deletes the audio afterward. Mac only so far. @ChatGPT in Slack and Teams means you can tag it in any channel and your teammates don't need their own license. Ultrafast makes Astra up to 8x quicker in Codex, restricted to Pro 500 and Enterprise. Now the part that got much less airtime. Pro 500 is a new $500 a month tier with 25x Plus usage.  And the existing $200 Pro plan just went from 20x Plus usage down to 10x in Codex and ChatGPT Work. Current subscribers keep their old limits for a while.
